assistant|citgo_refineries_locations: CITGO operates three refineries in the United States: Lake Charles, Louisiana; Lemont, Illinois; and Corpus Christi, Texas

assistant|lemont_refinery_processes: Lemont Refinery processes include atmospheric distillation, delayed coking, hydrocracking, and hydrotreating
assistant|corpus_christi_refinery_proces: Corpus Christi Refinery processes include atmospheric distillation, fluid catalytic cracking (FCC), alkylation, hydrocracking, and hydrotreating
assistant|refinery_processes_vary_note: Specific refining processes used can vary depending on the type of crude oil being processed and market demand for petroleum products
assistant|yield_rec_process_optimization: Refineries can maximize yield of high-value products by optimizing operating conditions such as temperature, pressure, and catalysts
assistant|yield_rec_equipment_upgrading: Upgrading equipment such as distillation columns and catalytic cracking units improves separation efficiency and yield of higher-value products
assistant|yield_rec_advanced_technologie: Computer modeling, simulation, and advanced process control systems help optimize processes, reduce waste, and maintain optimal operating conditions
assistant|yield_rec_feedstock_quality: Working with suppliers to receive the highest-quality crude oil possible improves yield of high-value products and reduces waste
assistant|yield_rec_waste_reduction: Implementing recycling programs, reducing emissions, and finding alternative uses for waste products reduces refining waste
assistant|yield_rec_continuous_monitorin: Continuously tracking product yields, energy consumption, costs, and equipment performance identifies areas where yield can be improved
assistant|yield_rec_energy_efficiency: Improving energy efficiency via heat recovery systems and reducing energy-intensive operations like pumping and compression
assistant|yield_rec_product_quality: Enhancing product quality by developing new formulations, improving purity, and reducing impurities to meet customer specifications
assistant|yield_rec_refinery_operations: Enhancing operations through best practices in safety, reliability, preventive maintenance, and reliability-centered maintenance strategies
assistant|yield_rec_byproduct_utilizatio: Converting by-product streams into saleable products or using them as fuel for power generation increases yield and reduces waste
assistant|yield_rec_research_development: Investing in research and development develops new refining processes and technologies to increase yield and reduce environmental impact
assistant|yield_rec_stakeholder_collabor: Collaborating with customers, suppliers, and regulatory agencies identifies opportunities to improve yield, reduce waste, and comply with regulations
assistant|catcracker_rec_operating_condi: Cat cracker yield improves by optimizing temperature, pressure, catalysts, and feed rates to maximize desired products

assistant|catcracker_rec_process_modelin: Computer modeling and simulation optimize the cat cracker process and allow testing new operating conditions before implementation
